--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[AI-1] Uncached Perplexity calls on user chat
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: Every POST to /api/perplexity/query forwards the user query to Perplexity via fetch with stream:false and no caching layer (no Redis/memoization/ETag). The client PerplexityChat component sends one API request per user message, so identical queries will re-run the external LLM every time.  
Impact: Cost grows linearly with active users/requests and is unbounded without caching — every concurrent user triggers a paid Perplexity call.  
Fix: Add a response cache (Redis or in-process LRU/semantic hash) keyed by normalized query+model and return cached results for recent identical requests.

[AI-2] No rate-limiting or throttles on AI route
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The route authenticates and checks plan but performs no per-user or global rate limit, queueing, or burst protection before calling the external API.  
Impact: API quota or budget can be exhausted instantly during spikes (unbounded/exhaustion risk), causing outages and runaway bills.  
Fix: Enforce per-user and global rate limits (token bucket), add request queuing/backpressure, and a fail-closed fallback when external API quota is reached.

[AI-3] Default uses expensive Perplexity model with no caps
File: src/services/perplexityService.ts (L1-L200) and src/components/PerplexityChat.tsx (L1-L420)
Evidence: DEFAULT_MODEL is sonar-deep-research (high-cost) and UI allows selecting heavy models; server forwards model directly with no budgeting, no model-cost-aware defaults, and no max tokens/response-size limits in the API call.  
Impact: Per-request cost may be very high and grows linearly per request but is effectively unbounded across users (high burn risk).  
Fix: Restrict default to a low-cost model, deny selection of premium models for free tiers, and enforce server-side model & response-size policies (max tokens, size-based caps).

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[AI-4] Responses are fetched non-streaming (UX latency)
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/components/PerplexityChat.tsx (L1-L420)
Evidence: The server sends stream: false to Perplexity and the client waits for the full response before showing assistant text (no streaming/partial renders).  
Impact: Perceived latency increases (worse UX) for long generations; does not directly increase API cost but harms throughput under load.  
Fix: Switch to streaming responses (if Perplexity supports it) or implement progressive rendering with chunked responses and server-sent events / ReadableStream.

--- INFO ---

[AI-5] Pro-plan gating reduces exposure
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The route checks user.isPro before allowing Perplexity access, which limits the exposed user set.
